current_business_claims.text: We Buy Junk Cars in Henderson — Get Cash Today.

Green Valley, Anthem, Lake Las Vegas, Inspirada, Seven Hills, and every neighborhood in between — Henderson residents get the same free towing, same-day pickup, and firm cash offers as anywhere in the valley.

Henderson is Nevada's second-largest city — around 332,000 residents spread across the southeastern edge of the valley, across master-planned communities, established neighborhoods, and newer developments.
Many of those communities are governed by a homeowners association, which means a junk car sitting in your driveway is not just an eyesore — it can become an expensive compliance problem.

Many Henderson neighborhoods — especially gated and master-planned communities like Green Valley Ranch, Anthem, Seven Hills, MacDonald Ranch, and Inspirada — have strict CC&R rules about inoperable, unregistered, or visibly damaged vehicles parked on driveways and streets.
Under Nevada's common-interest community statutes, a violation that is not corrected can draw a fine for each period it remains outstanding, following a written notice and an opportunity to be heard.
That pressure is exactly why Henderson is one of our busiest service areas.
Homeowners call because they need a junk car gone — fast — without the hassle of listing it online, negotiating with strangers, or figuring out the title paperwork on their own.
We handle the entire process: a firm cash offer over the phone, free towing to your address, and payment before we leave.
Most Henderson pickups happen the same day the owner calls.
Henderson covers over 100 square miles and dozens of distinct communities.
Here are the situations we handle most often.
Call {phone} and tell us your cross streets or zip code.

HOA Violations for Inoperable Vehicles Henderson has one of the highest concentrations of HOA-governed communities in Clark County.

If your community association has sent you a warning letter about an inoperable, unregistered, or visually damaged vehicle on your property, we can typically pick it up within hours of your call — well within most HOA compliance windows.

Inherited or Unused Vehicles in 55+ Communities Sun City Anthem, Sun City MacDonald Ranch, and other age-restricted communities in Henderson are home to thousands of residents who may have a second vehicle they no longer drive.
We will buy the remaining shell — even with a salvage title — and tow it away for free.
Vehicles With No Title If the title is lost, you can apply to the Nevada DMV for a duplicate using Form VP-012.
The title fee is $20 for a vehicle that stays in Nevada, plus an $8.25 title processing fee charged on every title transaction.
Whether a sale can proceed without the original title depends on the vehicle's circumstances, so it is worth asking before you assume either way.
